overview.summary: Deliver five qualified public-web components and adopt them in Lattice and Meadow. Add docs search, date input, the Relic and site-config fixes, and the optional 0.14 interaction work in the PRD’s cut order.

sharedDecisions.title: Suite placement, timing and qualification
sharedDecisions.description: S01 extends place(anchor, popup, {side, align, offset}) and trackPopup without changing the bottom/start/4 defaults. hoverIntent({open, close, openDelay, closeDelay}) returns enter, leave and cancel callbacks. Consumers share this positioning and timing code. ADR-012 records the 700-owned-line and 30,000-byte combined gzip limits before they take effect.

sharedDecisions.title: Port provenance at the existing shadcn tag
sharedDecisions.description: Each component story extends pins.json at the current commit, runs port.dart fetch and build, and verifies its own upstream file in vendor/shadcn/<tag>/SOURCE.md, generated/report.json and slot parity. Keep the prior tag-transition report and sync-inventory.json as historical evidence. At the next actual tag transition, record template and hand-CSS deltas (at most four and three lines per component, respectively) and obtain the maintainer’s sync signoff at release prep.

sharedDecisions.title: Integrated release qualification
sharedDecisions.description: After all retained stories land on feat/0.15, run CI=true mise run release-gate on the macOS baseline host. Regenerate affected records against that integrated revision, check the active upstream sync report, and rerun affected manual items at release prep before squash. The final sweep applies to the selected scope even if an optional story was cut.
